meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.coverage: Forward premia every trading day: annualised premia (1, 3, 6 months) and forward cash premia in paise
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 698. Two layouts in one table: annualised premia in per cent a year, and forward cash premia in paise per dollar. The table's reference-rate column mixes the dollar and the euro on the same day with no currency named, so it is left out; the reference rate is in external-rupee-daily. Trading days only.
